description: This file contains the implementation of a generic LoggerAdapter class that adapts the Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.ILogger interface to the IAppLogger interface used within the application, providing methods for logging warnings and informational messages.

classes.name: LoggerAdapter<T>
classes.description: A generic class that implements IAppLogger<T> by wrapping an ILogger<T> instance, facilitating logging operations within the application.

methods.name: LoggerAdapter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the logger instance using the provided ILoggerFactory.

methods.name: LogWarning
methods.description: Logs a warning message with optional arguments.

methods.name: LogInformation
methods.description: Logs an informational message with optional arguments.
